question: How many hospitals (including small clinics + nursing homes) are there in India?
idealClarificationQuestions: Definition: any healthcare facility with at least 1 bed? Yes — all bedded facilities.
Government + private + non-profit + nursing homes? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Sum of govt + private + nursing homes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Combined: ~1 lakh bedded hospitals + ~6 lakh clinics/dispensaries.

calculationFlow: Combined: ~1 lakh bedded hospitals + ~6 lakh clinics/dispensaries.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Combined: ~1 lakh bedded hospitals + ~6 lakh clinics/dispensaries.
